historical_quarantine.rule: These files remain review evidence only. No project, sheet, symbol, net or designator may be copied into native R2 without reconciliation against this inventory. The removable M5 Cap is supported by the host interface; Leshy2 does not manufacture a custom LoRa-Cap PCB.
